title: Reading a hosted configuration
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers, let $tr$ be a transition function for a $k$-work-tape binary machine with states indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$, and let $c'$ and $e$ be configurations related by the compiled representation. For any loop-control state $q$, tape content $ct: br\to\text{Option}(\text{Bool})$, offset $cp$, tag $b$, input-head position $p$, and output prefix, the virtual-host configuration built from the loop configuration at state $q$ has state $(q,b)$, input-head position $p$, output equal to the prefix followed by $e$'s output, and the symbol read on the bank tape corresponding to the summary tape is the output summary of $c'$'s output.
